long_biography.plain_text:
A Stanford product-design project became the starting point for Evan Spiegel's work on Snapchat. He and fellow student Bobby Murphy developed a camera-first service around disappearing images, aiming to make online conversation feel less permanent. The later Stories format let people assemble a day's moments into a sequence instead of maintaining a permanent public feed.

Spiegel left Stanford before completing his degree as the company expanded, then returned to finish it in 2018. With his wife, Miranda Kerr, he established the Spiegel Family Fund to support the arts, education, housing and human rights. In 2022, the fund made Otis College's largest single gift, helping its graduating class repay student loans.
long_biography.html:
A Stanford product-design project became the starting point for Evan Spiegel's work on Snapchat. He and fellow student Bobby Murphy developed a camera-first service around disappearing images, aiming to make online conversation feel less permanent. The later Stories format let people assemble a day's moments into a sequence instead of maintaining a permanent public feed.

Spiegel left Stanford before completing his degree as the company expanded, then returned to finish it in 2018. With his wife, Miranda Kerr, he established the Spiegel Family Fund to support the arts, education, housing and human rights. In 2022, the fund made Otis College's largest single gift, helping its graduating class repay student loans.
